```{r}
# ============================================================
# 病历整理 + 问卷病历匹配
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)

# ============================================================
# 1. 基础函数
# ============================================================

clean_id <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("")
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[\r\n\t]", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\u3000", " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    na_if("")
}

has_text <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) &
    str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""
}

parse_age <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      str_extract(
        as.character(x),
        "\\d+\\.?\\d*"
      )
    )
  )
}

parse_date <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.Date(
      parse_date_time(
        as.character(x),
        orders = c(
          "ymd HMS",
          "ymd HM",
          "ymd",
          "Ymd HMS",
          "Ymd HM",
          "Ymd"
        ),
        tz = "Asia/Shanghai",
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  )
}

normalize_sex <- function(x) {

  z <- clean_text(x)

  case_when(
    z %in% c("男", "男性", "男孩", "男童") ~ "男",
    z %in% c("女", "女性", "女孩", "女童") ~ "女",
    str_to_lower(z) %in% c("m", "male") ~ "男",
    str_to_lower(z) %in% c("f", "female") ~ "女",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

parse_submit_time <- function(x) {

  z <- str_squish(as.character(x)) %>%
    str_replace("\\s+CST\\s+", " ") %>%
    str_replace("\\s+CST$", "")

  suppressWarnings(
    parse_date_time(
      z,
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "a b d HMS Y"
      ),
      tz = "Asia/Shanghai",
      locale = "C",
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )
}

# 允许栏目汉字之间存在空格
# 例如“现 病 史”
label_regex <- function(label) {
  paste(
    strsplit(
      label,
      "",
      fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]],
    collapse = "\\s*"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 2. 心理、精神检查类栏目
# ============================================================

assessment_headers <- c(
  "心理检查结果",
  "心理检查",

  "心理测试结果",
  "心理测试",

  "心理测验结果",
  "心理测验",

  "心理测评结果",
  "心理测评",

  "心理评估结果",
  "心理评估",

  "精神检查结果",
  "精神状态检查",
  "精神科检查",
  "精神检查",

  "测评结果",
  "评估结果",

  "脑电生物点反馈",
  "脑电生物电反馈",

  "沙盘结果",
  "沙盘总结",
  "沙盘",

  "韦氏智力测评",
  "瑞文智力测评",
  "智力测评",

  "症状自评量表",
"症状自评",

  "注意力诊断量表",

# 较长的名称先匹配
# 防止“心理检查”提前匹配“心理检查结果”
assessment_headers <- assessment_headers[
  order(
    nchar(assessment_headers),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
]

section_headers <- c(
  "陪诊人",
  "主诉",
  "现病史",

  "既往史",
  "过敏史",
  "流行病学史",
  "个人史",
  "家族史",

  "体格检查",
  "专科查体",
  "专科检查",
  "辅助检查",

  assessment_headers,

# ============================================================
# 3. 新病历处理
# 心身医学科精神科.xls
# ============================================================

standardize_note <- function(text) {

  if (
    is.na(text) ||
      str_squish(as.character(text)) == ""
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- as.character(text) %>%
    str_replace_all("\r\n|\r", "\n") %>%
    str_replace_all("\u3000", " ")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 识别带冒号的标准栏目
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (header in section_headers) {

    # 心理检查类栏目和日期只在行首识别
    # 防止把连续病史中的普通描述错误拆开
    if (
      header %in%
        c(
          assessment_headers,
          "日期"
        )
    ) {

      header_pattern <- paste0(
        "(?m)^\\s*",
        label_regex(header),
        "\\s*[:：]"
      )

    } else {

      # 其他标准病历栏目允许不规范连续书写
      header_pattern <- paste0(
        label_regex(header),
        "\\s*[:：]"
      )
    }

    x <- str_replace_all(
      x,
      regex(header_pattern),
      paste0(
        "\n",
        header,
        "："
      )
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 识别没有冒号但独立成行的栏目
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (header in section_headers) {

    x <- str_replace_all(
      x,
      regex(
        paste0(
          "(?m)^\\s*",
          label_regex(header),
          "\\s*$"
        )
      ),
      paste0(
        "\n",
        header,
        "："
      )
    )
  }

  x
}

# 提取指定栏目
extract_section <- function(x, label) {

  if (is.na(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  key <- paste0(
    label,
    "："
  )

  start_loc <- str_locate(
    x,
    fixed(key)
  )

  if (is.na(start_loc[1])) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  out <- str_sub(
    x,
    start_loc[2] + 1
  )

  other_headers <- setdiff(
    section_headers,
    label
  )

  next_loc <- str_locate(
    out,
    regex(
      paste0(
        "\\n\\s*(?:",
        paste(
          other_headers,
          collapse = "|"
        ),
        ")："
      )
    )
  )

  if (!is.na(next_loc[1])) {
    out <- str_sub(
      out,
      1,
      next_loc[1] - 1
    )
  }

  clean_text(out)
}

# 提取新病历日期
extract_note_date <- function(x) {

  if (
    is.na(x) ||
      str_squish(as.character(x)) == ""
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- as.character(x)

  # 优先使用明确的“日期/就诊日期”栏目
  explicit_date <- str_match(
    x,
    regex(
      paste0(
        "(?m)^\\s*",
        "(?:就\\s*诊\\s*)?",
        "日\\s*期\\s*[:：]\\s*",
        "(\\d{4}[-/.]\\d{1,2}[-/.]\\d{1,2})"
      )
    )
  )[, 2]

  if (!is.na(explicit_date)) {
    return(
      str_replace_all(
        explicit_date,
        "[/.]",
        "-"
      )
    )
  }

  # 没有“日期”二字时，
  # 采用唯一的独立日期行
  standalone_matches <- str_match_all(
    x,
    regex(
      paste0(
        "(?m)^\\s*",
        "(\\d{4}[-/.]\\d{1,2}[-/.]\\d{1,2})",
        "\\s*$"
      )
    )
  )[[1]]

  if (nrow(standalone_matches) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  standalone_dates <- standalone_matches[, 2] %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "[/.]",
      "-"
    ) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(standalone_dates) == 1) {
    return(standalone_dates[1])
  }

  # 多个不同日期时不猜测
  NA_character_
}

# 新病历病史提取
extract_history_text <- function(note_std) {

  if (is.na(note_std)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # A. 有明确“现病史”标题
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  structured_history <- extract_section(
    note_std,
    label = "现病史"
  )

  if (has_text(structured_history)) {
    return(structured_history)
  }

  # 有“现病史”标题但标题后为空
  # 不使用整份病历替代
  if (
    str_detect(
      note_std,
      fixed("现病史：")
    )
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # B. 没有“现病史”标题
  # 使用无结构正文备用提取
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- note_std %>%
    str_replace(
      "^\\s*[:：]+\\s*",
      ""
    )

  # 陪诊人、主诉、现病史不作为备用正文停止位置
  fallback_stop_headers <- setdiff(
    section_headers,
    c(
      "陪诊人",
      "主诉",
      "现病史"
    )
  )

  stop_pattern <- paste(
    vapply(
      fallback_stop_headers,
      label_regex,
      character(1)
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  )

  stop_loc <- str_locate(
    x,
    regex(
      paste0(
        "\\n\\s*(?:",
        stop_pattern,
        ")\\s*[:：]?"
      )
    )
  )

  if (!is.na(stop_loc[1])) {
    x <- str_sub(
      x,
      1,
      stop_loc[1] - 1
    )
  }

  x <- x %>%
    str_replace(
      "\\s*[:：]+\\s*$",
      ""
    ) %>%
    clean_text()

  if (!has_text(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  substantive_text <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "[^\\p{Han}A-Za-z0-9]",
    ""
  )

  # 无标题备用文本太短时不采用
  if (
    substantive_text == "" ||
      nchar(substantive_text) < 20
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x
}

# 明确属于后续病历栏目的标题
# 一旦出现，就从这里开始截断
old_stop_headers <- c(
  "既往史",
  "过敏史",
  "流行病学史",
  "个人史",
  "家族史",

  "体格检查",
  "专科查体",
  "专科检查",
  "辅助检查",

  "诊断",
  "诊疗计划",
  "表格<诊断>内容",
  "表格<处置>内容",
  "医师签名"
)

# 旧病历中夹在连续文本里的心理/精神检查
old_assessment_headers <- c(
  "心理检查",
  "心理测试",
  "心理测验",
  "心理测评",
  "心理评估",
  "测评结果",
  "评估结果",
  "精神检查",
  "精神状态检查",
  "精神科检查"
)

# 心理/精神评估标题前允许出现的来源前缀
# 例如：
# 当地心理测试：
# 安定医院心理测试：
# 华信医院：心理测试：
assessment_lead_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?:",
    "(?:当地|本院|外院)\\s*",
    "|",
    "(?:在|于)?\\s*",
    "[\\p{Han}A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}",
    "(?:医院|中心|门诊|诊所)",
    "\\s*[:：]?\\s*",
  ")?"
)
# 删除心理、精神检查所在的当前句子
# 不截掉其后的所有病史
remove_old_assessment_sentences <- function(x) {

  if (
    is.na(x) ||
      str_squish(as.character(x)) == ""
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  assessment_pattern <- paste(
    vapply(
      assessment_headers,
      label_regex,
      character(1)
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  )

  sentence_pattern <- regex(
    paste0(
      # 全文开头，或标点、换行之后
      # 英文句点后面不是数字时，才视为句末
      "(^|[。！？!?．，,；;\\n]|\\.(?!\\d))\\s*",

      # 可选的来源或机构前缀
      # 例如：当地、安定医院、华信医院：
      assessment_lead_pattern,

      # 心理、精神、量表类标题
      "(?:",
      assessment_pattern,
      ")",

      # 支持：
      # 心理测试：……
      # 心理测试结果：……
      # 心理测试显示：……
      "(?:",
        "\\s*(?:结果)?\\s*[:：]",
        "|",
        "\\s*(?:结果)?\\s*",
        "(?:显示|提示|表明|发现|为)",
        "\\s*[:：]?",
      ")\\s*",

      # 非贪婪匹配评估内容
      "[\\s\\S]*?",

      # 中文句末、换行、全文结尾，
      # 或后面不是数字的英文句点
      "(?:[。！？!?．\\n]|\\.(?!\\d)|$)"
    )
  )

  x <- as.character(x)

  # 循环处理连续出现的多段评估
  # 例如：心理测试……。症状自评……
  repeat {

    old_x <- x

    x <- str_replace_all(
      x,
      sentence_pattern,
      "\\1"
    )

    if (identical(x, old_x)) {
      break
    }
  }

  x
}


clean_old_history <- function(x) {

  if (
    is.na(x) ||
      str_squish(as.character(x)) == ""
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- as.character(x)

  # 删除开头重复的“现病史：”
  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^\\s*现\\s*病\\s*史\\s*[:：]\\s*"
    ),
    ""
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 删除夹在正文中的心理/精神检查整句
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- remove_old_assessment_sentences(x)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 遇到个人史、家族史、辅助检查等栏目时截断
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  stop_pattern <- paste(
    vapply(
      old_stop_headers,
      label_regex,
      character(1)
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  )

  stop_loc <- str_locate(
    x,
    regex(
      paste0(
        "(?:",
        stop_pattern,
        ")\\s*[:：]"
      )
    )
  )

  if (!is.na(stop_loc[1])) {
    x <- str_sub(
      x,
      1,
      stop_loc[1] - 1
    )
  }

  # 清理删除后残留的标点
  x %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "[，,；;]{2,}",
      "；"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "([。！？])\\s*[，,；;]",
      "\\1"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "^[，,。；;：:、]+|[，,。；;：:、]+$",
      ""
    ) %>%
    clean_text()
}
# 删除新病历现病史中夹杂的行内心理、精神检查结果
remove_inline_assessment_text <- function(x) {

  x <- remove_old_assessment_sentences(x)

  if (is.na(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "。{2,}",
      "。"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "([。！？.!?．])\\s*[，,；;]",
      "\\1"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "\\s+([，,。；;：:、！？.!?．])",
      "\\1"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "^[，,。；;：:、！？.!?．]+|[，,。；;：:、！？.!?．]+$",
      ""
    ) %>%
    clean_text()
}

cmp_old <- read_excel(
  here(
    "DATA",
    "Complains_YoungClients.xls"
  ),
  .name_repair = "unique"
)

cmp_new <- read_excel(
  here(
    "DATA",
    "心身医学科精神科.xls"
  ),
  .name_repair = "unique"
)

names(cmp_old) <- str_squish(
  names(cmp_old)
)

names(cmp_new) <- str_squish(
  names(cmp_new)
)

# ============================================================
# 6. 整理旧病历
# ============================================================

cmp_old_min <- cmp_old %>%
  transmute(
    ID =
      clean_id(门诊ID),

    visit_date =
      parse_date(就诊日期),

    age_medical =
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          parse_date(就诊日期),
          parse_date(出生日期),
          units = "days"
        )
      ) / 365.25,

    sex =
      NA_character_,

    diagnosis =
      clean_text(诊断),

    chief_complaint =
      clean_text(主诉),

    history_text = vapply(
      现病史,
      clean_old_history,
      character(1)
    ),

    source_type =
      "old_complains",

    history_source = if_else(
      has_text(history_text),
      "structured_old",
      "missing"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. 整理新病历
# ============================================================

cmp_new_min <- cmp_new %>%
  mutate(
    note_std = vapply(
      病历信息,
      standardize_note,
      character(1)
    ),

    history_text_tmp = vapply(
      note_std,
      extract_history_text,
      character(1)
    ),

    history_text_tmp = vapply(
      history_text_tmp,
      remove_inline_assessment_text,
      character(1)
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    ID =
      clean_id(门诊号),

    visit_date = parse_date(
      vapply(
        note_std,
        extract_note_date,
        character(1)
      )
    ),

    age_medical =
      parse_age(年龄),

    sex =
      normalize_sex(性别),

    diagnosis =
      clean_text(诊断),

    # 主诉保留用于代诊排除
    # 不作为模型病史文本
    chief_complaint = vapply(
      note_std,
      extract_section,
      character(1),
      label = "主诉"
    ),

    history_text =
      history_text_tmp,

    source_type =
      "new_psychosomatic",

    history_source = case_when(
      has_text(history_text_tmp) &
        str_detect(
          coalesce(note_std, ""),
          fixed("现病史：")
        ) ~ "structured_new",

      has_text(history_text_tmp) ~
        "unstructured_fallback",

      TRUE ~
        "missing"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. 合并病历
# ============================================================

cmp_all <- bind_rows(
  cmp_old_min,
  cmp_new_min
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ID),
    ID != ""
  )

raw <- raw %>%

# 10. 整理病历候选记录
# ============================================================

cmp <- cmp_all %>%
  transmute(
    门诊ID =
      clean_id(ID),

    就诊日期 =
      as.Date(visit_date),

    年龄_病历 =
      as.numeric(age_medical),

    性别 =
      normalize_sex(sex),

    主诉 =
      chief_complaint,

    现病史 =
      history_text,

    诊断 =
      diagnosis,

    source_type,
    history_source
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(门诊ID),
    门诊ID != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cmp_row_id =
      row_number(),

info_score =
  ifelse(has_text(现病史), 1000, 0) +
  ifelse(has_text(诊断), 500, 0) +
  ifelse(has_text(主诉), 200, 0) +
  ifelse(!is.na(年龄_病历), 50, 0) +
  ifelse(!is.na(性别), 20, 0)
  )

cmp_output_cols <- c(
  "门诊ID",
  "就诊日期",
  "年龄_病历",
  "性别",
  "主诉",
  "现病史",
  "诊断",

)

# ============================================================
# 12. 每个日期保留一条候选记录
# ============================================================

raw_candidates <- raw %>%
  filter(
    ID %in% common_ids
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    ID,
    submit_date
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    submit_time,
    raw_row_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    raw_row_id,
    ID,
    submit_time,
    submit_date
  )

cmp_candidates <- cmp %>%
  filter(
    门诊ID %in% common_ids
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    门诊ID,
    就诊日期
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(info_score),
    cmp_row_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    cmp_row_id,
    门诊ID,
    就诊日期,
    info_score
  )

# ============================================================
# 13. 同一ID选择日期最接近的一对
# ============================================================

matched_index <- raw_candidates %>%
  inner_join(
    cmp_candidates,
    by = c(
      "ID" = "门诊ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff = abs(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          submit_date,
          就诊日期,
          units = "days"
        )
      )
    ),

    time_diff = ifelse(
      is.na(time_diff),
      Inf,
      time_diff
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  arrange(
    time_diff,
    desc(info_score),
    submit_time,
    raw_row_id,
    cmp_row_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# 14. 生成最终数据
# ============================================================

matched_raw <- matched_index %>%
  select(raw_row_id) %>%
  left_join(
    raw,
    by = "raw_row_id"
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(raw_original_cols)
  )

matched_cmp <- matched_index %>%
  select(cmp_row_id) %>%
  left_join(
    cmp,
    by = "cmp_row_id"
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(cmp_output_cols)
  )

raw_only <- raw %>%
  filter(
    ID %in% only_raw_ids
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  arrange(
    submit_time,
    raw_row_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    all_of(raw_original_cols)
  )

cmp_only <- cmp %>%
  filter(
    门诊ID %in% only_cmp_ids
  ) %>%
  group_by(门诊ID) %>%
  arrange(
    is.na(就诊日期),
    就诊日期,
    desc(info_score),
    cmp_row_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    all_of(cmp_output_cols)
  )

Raw_output <- bind_rows(
  matched_raw,
  raw_only
)

Cmp_output <- bind_rows(
  matched_cmp,
  cmp_only
)

# ============================================================
# 15. 问卷性别补充病历性别
# ============================================================

gender_lookup <- Raw_output %>%
  transmute(
    门诊ID =
      clean_id(ID),

    性别_问卷 =
      normalize_sex(Gender)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    门诊ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

Cmp_output <- Cmp_output %>%
  left_join(
    gender_lookup,
    by = "门诊ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    性别 = coalesce(
      normalize_sex(性别),
      性别_问卷
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -性别_问卷
  )

# ============================================================
# 16. 保存
# ============================================================

saveRDS(
  Raw_output,
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Raw_output.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  Cmp_output,
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Complains_output.rds"
  )
)

write.xlsx(
  Raw_output,
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Raw_output.xlsx"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Cmp_output,
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Complains_output.xlsx"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 17. 简单检查
# ============================================================

history_qc <- Cmp_output %>%
  count(
    source_type,
    history_source,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    source_type,
    history_source
  )

print(history_qc)

cat(
  "\n处理完成。\n",
  "病历唯一ID：",
  n_distinct(Cmp_output$门诊ID),
  "\n问卷唯一ID：",
  n_distinct(Raw_output$ID),
  "\n无现病史标题但成功提取的人数：",
  sum(
    Cmp_output$history_source ==
      "unstructured_fallback",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 清洗病历数据
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)

# ============================================================
# 1. 读取数据
# ============================================================

Cmp_output <- readRDS(
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output.rds")
)

Raw_output <- readRDS(
  here("OUTPUT", "Raw_output.rds")
)

names(Cmp_output) <- str_squish(names(Cmp_output))
names(Raw_output) <- str_squish(names(Raw_output))

# ============================================================
# 2. 基础函数
# ============================================================

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[\r\n\t]", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\u3000", " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    na_if("")
}

parse_age <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      str_extract(
        as.character(x),
        "\\d+\\.?\\d*"
      )
    )
  )
}

clean_diagnosis <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[\r\n\t]+", ";") %>%
    str_replace_all("；", ";") %>%
    str_replace_all(";{2,}", ";") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace(";+$", "") %>%
    str_replace("^;+", "") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("")
}

# ============================================================
# 3. 病历文本清洗规则
# ============================================================

bad_tail <- paste0(
  "多动冲动严重程度学习问题情绪问题品行自尊心",
  "厌学病程饮食睡眠共患病治疗过程"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 删除明确的诊断泄漏
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 删除：
# 抑郁状态
# 抑郁障碍
# 抑郁发作
# 抑郁症
# 焦虑抑郁
# 诊断为中度抑郁障碍
#
# 保留：
# 抑郁症状
# 焦虑抑郁症状
# 抑郁情绪
diagnosis_leak_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(?:诊断(?:为)?\\s*)?",
    "(?:轻度|中度|重度|严重|非常严重)?\\s*",
    "(?:",
      "抑郁状态|",
      "抑郁障碍|",
      "抑郁发作|",
      "抑郁症(?!状)|",
      "焦虑抑郁症(?!状)|",
      "焦虑抑郁(?=\\s*(?:$|[，,。；;：:、]))",
    ")"
  )
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.2 常见量表名称
# ------------------------------------------------------------

scale_core <- paste(
  c(
    # 英文量表或简称
    "PHQ[-－]?9",
    "DASS[-－]?21",
    "SCARED",
    "DSRSC",
    "SAS",
    "SDS",
    "CDI",
    "DASS",
    "PHQ",
    "HAMD(?:[-－]?\\d+)?",
    "HAMA(?:[-－]?\\d+)?",
    "SCL[-－]?90",
    "Conners",
    "CBCL",
    "SDQ",

    # 中文量表及常见写法
    "汉密尔顿(?:抑郁|焦虑)?(?:量表)?",
    "症状自评(?:量表)?",
    "儿童行为量表",
    "注意力评估量表",
    "注意力诊断量表",
    "困难量表",
    "压力测评",
    "艾森克人格(?:问卷)?",
    "韦氏(?:智力(?:测评|测试)?|测评|测试)",
    "瑞文(?:智力(?:测评|测试)?|测评|测试)"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.3 删除“量表名称 + 分数”
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 可识别：
# PHQ-9：14分
# PHQ-9得分为14分
# HAMD-17总分24
# 汉密尔顿29分
# 韦氏智力测评106
scale_score_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(",
      scale_core,
    ")",
    "\\s*[（(]?\\s*",
    "(?:总分|评分|得分|结果)?\\s*",
    "(?:为|[:：=])?\\s*",
    "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?",
    "(?![\\d.])",
    "(?!\\s*(?:分钟|分后|分前|小时|天|周|月|年|岁|次))",
    "\\s*分?\\s*[)）]?"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# 删除清理分数后残留的量表名称
scale_name_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(",
      scale_core,
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.4 模型文本清洗函数
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_model_text <- function(x) {

  x <- clean_text(x)

  # 删除异常拼接尾部
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    fixed(bad_tail),
    ""
  )

  # 删除明确诊断泄漏
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    diagnosis_leak_pattern,
    ""
  )

  # 先删除“量表名称 + 分数”
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    scale_score_pattern,
    ""
  )

  # 再删除残留的量表名称
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    scale_name_pattern,
    ""
  )

  # 清理删除后产生的重复标点
  x %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "[，,；;：:、]{2,}",
      "；"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "[。]{2,}",
      "。"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "\\s+([，,。；;：:、])",
      "\\1"
    ) %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "^[，,。；;：:、]+|[，,。；;：:、]+$",
      ""
    ) %>%
    clean_text()
}
# ============================================================
# 4. 问卷年龄查找表
# ============================================================

age_lookup <- Raw_output %>%
  transmute(
    门诊ID = str_trim(
      as.character(ID)
    ),
    年龄_问卷 = parse_age(Age)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(门诊ID),
    门诊ID != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    门诊ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# 5. 基础整理
# ============================================================

Cmp_step0 <- Cmp_output %>%
  mutate(
    门诊ID = str_trim(
      as.character(门诊ID)
    ),
    年龄_病历 = parse_age(
      年龄_病历
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    age_lookup,
    by = "门诊ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 病历年龄优先，问卷年龄补缺
    Age = coalesce(
      年龄_病历,
      年龄_问卷
    ),

    Age_source = case_when(
      !is.na(年龄_病历) ~ "Medical record",

      is.na(年龄_病历) &
        !is.na(年龄_问卷) ~ "Questionnaire",

      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    ),

    # 用于后续模型的文本
    现病史 = clean_model_text(现病史),
    主诉 = clean_model_text(主诉),

    # 诊断用于定义标签，不删除诊断词
    诊断 = clean_text(诊断)
  )

n0 <- nrow(Cmp_step0)

# ============================================================
# 6. Step 1：清洗后现病史非空
# ============================================================

Cmp_step1 <- Cmp_step0 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(现病史),
    现病史 != ""
  )

n1 <- nrow(Cmp_step1)

# ============================================================
# 7. Step 2：年龄 7–18 岁
# ============================================================

Cmp_step2 <- Cmp_step1 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Age),
    Age >= 7,
    Age < 19
  )

n2 <- nrow(Cmp_step2)

# ============================================================
# 8. Step 3：去掉代诊
# ============================================================

proxy_pattern <- paste0(
  "代诊|代诉|代述|代为咨询|家属代|父亲代|母亲代|",
  "父母代|未见患儿|未到诊|未到场|孩子未到场"
)

Cmp_step3 <- Cmp_step2 %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(
      coalesce(主诉, ""),
      proxy_pattern
    ),

    !str_detect(
      coalesce(现病史, ""),
      proxy_pattern
    )
  )

n3 <- nrow(Cmp_step3)

# ============================================================
# 9. Step 4：诊断非空 + 标准化诊断
# ============================================================

Cmp_step4 <- Cmp_step3 %>%
  mutate(
    诊断_clean = clean_diagnosis(诊断)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(诊断_clean),
    诊断_clean != ""
  )

n4 <- nrow(Cmp_step4)

# ============================================================
# 10. 清洗流程统计
# ============================================================

cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
  step = c(
    "初始去重病历",
    "文本清洗后现病史非空",
    "年龄7-18岁",
    "去掉代诊",
    "诊断非空"
  ),

  n_remaining = c(
    n0,
    n1,
    n2,
    n3,
    n4
  ),

  n_removed_from_previous = c(
    NA,
    n0 - n1,
    n1 - n2,
    n2 - n3,
    n3 - n4
  )
)

print(cleaning_summary)

# ============================================================
# 11. 诊断统计
# ============================================================

diagnosis_full_freq <- Cmp_step4 %>%
  count(
    诊断_clean,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n),
    诊断_clean
  )

pure_dep_labels <- c(
  "抑郁状态",
  "抑郁障碍"
)

diagnosis_key_summary <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "四步清洗后总样本量",
    "仅诊断为抑郁状态",
    "仅诊断为抑郁障碍",
    "纯抑郁合计",
    "含抑郁但非纯抑郁",
    "不含抑郁"
  ),

  n = c(
    nrow(Cmp_step4),

    sum(
      Cmp_step4$诊断_clean ==
        "抑郁状态"
    ),

    sum(
      Cmp_step4$诊断_clean ==
        "抑郁障碍"
    ),

    sum(
      Cmp_step4$诊断_clean %in%
        pure_dep_labels
    ),

    sum(
      str_detect(
        Cmp_step4$诊断_clean,
        "抑郁"
      ) &
        !Cmp_step4$诊断_clean %in%
        pure_dep_labels
    ),

    sum(
      !str_detect(
        Cmp_step4$诊断_clean,
        "抑郁"
      )
    )
  )
)

print(diagnosis_key_summary)

# ============================================================
# 12. 导出
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Summary = cleaning_summary,
    Diagnosis_key = diagnosis_key_summary,
    Diagnosis_full = diagnosis_full_freq,
    Clean_data = Cmp_step4
  ),

  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Complains_clean_step1_to_step4.xlsx"
  ),

  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\n清洗完成，已导出：",
  "OUTPUT/Complains_clean_step1_to_step4.xlsx\n"
)
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 输出研究数据 + ML 数据 + 人口学统计
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

# ============================================================
# 1. 定义诊断组
# ============================================================

pure_dep_labels <- c("抑郁状态", "抑郁障碍")

Cmp_depression_pure <- Cmp_step4 %>%
  filter(诊断_clean %in% pure_dep_labels)

Cmp_non_depression <- Cmp_step4 %>%
  filter(!str_detect(诊断_clean, "抑郁"))

# ============================================================
# 2. 生成带诊断标签的问卷
# ============================================================

Dep_label <- bind_rows(
  Cmp_depression_pure %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      Depression_status = "Depression"
    ),

  Cmp_non_depression %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      Depression_status = "Non-depression"
    )
)

Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label <- Raw_output %>%
  mutate(ID = str_trim(as.character(ID))) %>%
  inner_join(
    Dep_label,
    by = "ID"
  )

Questionnaire_Depression_Pure <-
  Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label %>%
  filter(Depression_status == "Depression")

# ============================================================
# 3. 导出基础研究数据
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  Cmp_depression_pure,
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Cmp_non_depression,
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_non_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label,
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Questionnaire_Depression_Pure,
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_Depression_Pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 4. 构建 1:1 平衡 ML 样本
# ============================================================

raw_ids <- unique(Raw_output$ID)

dep_pool <- Cmp_depression_pure %>%
  filter(门诊ID %in% raw_ids)

non_pool <- Cmp_non_depression %>%
  filter(门诊ID %in% raw_ids)

n_dep <- nrow(dep_pool)

set.seed(20240211)

dep_sel <- dep_pool %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    history_text = 现病史,
    label = 1L
  )

non_sel <- non_pool %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_dep) %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    history_text = 现病史,
    label = 0L
  )

y_label <- bind_rows(
  dep_sel,
  non_sel
)

# ============================================================
# 5. 问卷计分
# ============================================================

dsrsc_items <- paste0("DSRSC", 1:18)
phq_items <- paste0("PHQ", 1:9)

dass_dep_items <- c(
  "DASS3", "DASS5", "DASS10",
  "DASS13", "DASS16", "DASS17", "DASS21"
)

cdi_items <- setdiff(
  paste0("CDI", 1:27),
  "CDI26"
)

CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10",
  "CDI11", "CDI13", "CDI15", "CDI16",
  "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

score_items <- c(
  dsrsc_items,
  phq_items,
  dass_dep_items,
  cdi_items
)

qdat <- Raw_output %>%
  filter(ID %in% y_label$ID) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(score_items), as.numeric),
    across(all_of(score_items), ~ .x - 1),
    across(all_of(CDI_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x),
    across(all_of(DSRSC_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_DSRSC = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(dsrsc_items)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_PHQ = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(phq_items)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_CDI = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(cdi_items)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_DASS = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(dass_dep_items)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ID,
    total_DSRSC,
    total_PHQ,
    total_CDI,
    total_DASS
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. ML 数据 + stratified 5-fold
# ============================================================

ml_data <- y_label %>%
  inner_join(
    qdat,
    by = "ID"
  )

set.seed(20240211)

ml_data <- ml_data %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  mutate(
    fold = sample(
      rep(1:5, length.out = n())
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    fold,
    desc(label)
  )

write.xlsx(
  ml_data,
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 7. 人口学信息统一来源
#
# Age  = 病历优先、问卷补缺后的最终年龄
# 性别 = 病历优先、问卷补缺后的最终性别
# ============================================================

demo_lookup <- Cmp_step4 %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    sex = as.character(性别)
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. 构建各研究样本的人口学数据
# ============================================================

cleaned_demo <- demo_lookup %>%
  mutate(
    sample_group = "Cleaned medical records"
  )

pure_dep_demo <- Cmp_depression_pure %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    Age,
    sex = 性别,
    sample_group = "Pure depression medical records"
  )

non_dep_demo <- Cmp_non_depression %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    Age,
    sex = 性别,
    sample_group = "Non-depression medical records"
  )

questionnaire_demo <-
  Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    diagnosis_group = Depression_status,
    sample_group = "Questionnaire with diagnosis label"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    demo_lookup,
    by = "ID"
  )

questionnaire_pure_demo <-
  Questionnaire_Depression_Pure %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    sample_group = "Pure depression questionnaire"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    demo_lookup,
    by = "ID"
  )

ml_demo <- ml_data %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    diagnosis_group = if_else(
      label == 1,
      "Depression",
      "Non-depression"
    ),
    sample_group = "Balanced ML dataset"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    demo_lookup,
    by = "ID"
  )

# ============================================================
# 9. 人口学统计函数
# ============================================================

demo_summary <- function(dat, group_col) {

  dat %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),

      age_mean = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_sd = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_median = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_q1 = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_q3 = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),

      male_n = sum(sex == "男", na.rm = TRUE),
      male_percent = male_n / n,

      female_n = sum(sex == "女", na.rm = TRUE),
      female_percent = female_n / n,

      sex_missing_n = sum(
        is.na(sex) | sex == ""
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 10. 各研究样本统计
# ============================================================

summary_samples <- bind_rows(
  cleaned_demo,
  pure_dep_demo,
  non_dep_demo,
  questionnaire_demo %>%
    select(ID, Age, sex, sample_group),
  questionnaire_pure_demo,
  ml_demo %>%
    select(ID, Age, sex, sample_group)
) %>%
  demo_summary(sample_group)

summary_questionnaire_by_label <-
  questionnaire_demo %>%
  demo_summary(diagnosis_group)

summary_ml_by_label <-
  ml_demo %>%
  demo_summary(diagnosis_group)

# ============================================================
# 11. 导出人口学统计
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Summary_samples = summary_samples,
    Questionnaire_by_label =
      summary_questionnaire_by_label,
    ML_by_label = summary_ml_by_label
  ),
  here(
    "OUTPUT",
    "Demographic_summary_age_sex.xlsx"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 12. 简单输出
# ============================================================

cat("纯抑郁病历：", nrow(Cmp_depression_pure), "\n")
cat("非抑郁病历：", nrow(Cmp_non_depression), "\n")
cat(
  "诊断标签问卷：",
  nrow(Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label),
  "\n"
)
cat("ML 样本：", nrow(ml_data), "\n\n")

print(summary_samples)
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(purrr)

# =========================================================
# 0. 读取纯抑郁版机器学习总数据
# =========================================================
ml_data <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text),
    label = as.integer(label)
  )

cat("总样本数：", nrow(ml_data), "\n")
cat("抑郁组样本数：", sum(ml_data$label == 1), "\n")
cat("非抑郁组样本数：", sum(ml_data$label == 0), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 1. 读取删词表（纯抑郁版）
#    注意：仍然按长度从长到短排序
# =========================================================
delete_m3 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M3_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m3 <- delete_m3[delete_m3 != ""]
delete_m3 <- delete_m3[order(nchar(delete_m3), decreasing = TRUE)]

delete_m4 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M4_augmented_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m4 <- delete_m4[delete_m4 != ""]
delete_m4 <- delete_m4[order(nchar(delete_m4), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("M3 表述数量：", length(delete_m3), "\n")
cat("M4 表述数量：", length(delete_m4), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 2. 核心函数：长表述优先，命中后遮罩，避免短表述重复命中
# =========================================================

# 用同长度遮罩字符替换，避免删掉后前后文本拼接造成误匹配
mask_phrase_fixed <- function(text, phrase, mask_char = "□") {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(text)
  mask_str <- str_dup(mask_char, str_length(phrase))
  str_replace_all(text, fixed(phrase), mask_str)
}

# 对一条文本做“非重叠命中检测”
# 返回：
# 1) hit_any：是否至少命中一个表述
# 2) n_hit：命中了多少个“不同表述条目”（非重叠）
# 3) hit_phrases：真正命中的表述列表（长表述优先，短表述不重复吃到）
# 4) masked_text：遮罩后的文本（便于debug）
detect_patterns_nonoverlap <- function(text, patterns) {
  if (is.na(text) || trimws(text) == "") {
    return(list(
      hit_any = FALSE,
      n_hit = 0L,
      hit_phrases = character(0),
      masked_text = text
    ))
  }

  working_text <- text
  hit_phrases <- character(0)

  for (p in patterns) {
    if (str_detect(working_text, fixed(p))) {
      hit_phrases <- c(hit_phrases, p)
      working_text <- mask_phrase_fixed(working_text, p)
    }
  }

  list(
    hit_any = length(hit_phrases) > 0,
    n_hit = length(hit_phrases),
    hit_phrases = hit_phrases,
    masked_text = working_text
  )
}

# 批量对一列文本跑非重叠命中
batch_detect_nonoverlap <- function(text_vec, patterns) {
  res <- lapply(text_vec, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  tibble(
    hit_any = vapply(res, function(x) x$hit_any, logical(1)),
    n_hit = vapply(res, function(x) x$n_hit, integer(1)),
    hit_phrases = vapply(res, function(x) paste(x$hit_phrases, collapse = " | "), character(1)),
    masked_text = vapply(res, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$masked_text) || is.na(x$masked_text)) "" else x$masked_text
    }, character(1))
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 3. 每个样本：是否命中、命中多少（非重叠版）
# =========================================================
m3_detect <- batch_detect_nonoverlap(ml_data$history_text, delete_m3)
m4_detect <- batch_detect_nonoverlap(ml_data$history_text, delete_m4)

ml_hit <- ml_data %>%
  mutate(
    hit_any_M3 = m3_detect$hit_any,
    hit_any_M4 = m4_detect$hit_any,
    n_hit_M3 = m3_detect$n_hit,
    n_hit_M4 = m4_detect$n_hit,
    hit_phrases_M3 = m3_detect$hit_phrases,
    hit_phrases_M4 = m4_detect$hit_phrases
  )

write.xlsx(
  ml_hit,
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_phrase_hits_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出样本级命中结果：ML_dataset_phrase_hits_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 4. 整体命中率比较（非重叠版）
# =========================================================
overall_summary <- ml_hit %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_hit_any_M3 = mean(hit_any_M3),
    prop_hit_any_M4 = mean(hit_any_M4),
    mean_n_hit_M3 = mean(n_hit_M3),
    mean_n_hit_M4 = mean(n_hit_M4),
    median_n_hit_M3 = median(n_hit_M3),
    median_n_hit_M4 = median(n_hit_M4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(label == 1, "Depression", "Non-depression")) %>%
  select(group, everything(), -label)

print(overall_summary)

write.xlsx(
  overall_summary,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_hit_overall_summary_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出整体命中率表：Phrase_hit_overall_summary_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 5. 单表述组间比较（非重叠归属版）
#    逻辑：
#    - 每条文本先按“长表述优先”做唯一归属
#    - 然后统计每个 phrase 在多少个样本中被归属命中
# =========================================================
phrase_summary_nonoverlap <- function(data, patterns, prefix_name) {
  # 先对所有样本做一次非重叠检测
  det_list <- lapply(data$history_text, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  # 展开成 样本 x phrase 的归属表
  hit_rows <- lapply(seq_along(det_list), function(i) {
    hp <- det_list[[i]]$hit_phrases
    if (length(hp) == 0) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      ID = data$ID[i],
      label = data$label[i],
      phrase = hp,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  hit_df <- bind_rows(hit_rows)

  n_dep <- sum(data$label == 1)
  n_non <- sum(data$label == 0)

  if (nrow(hit_df) == 0) {
    out <- data.frame(
      phrase = patterns,
      dep_hits = 0,
      non_hits = 0,
      dep_prop = 0,
      non_prop = 0,
      diff_prop = 0,
      ratio_prop = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    out <- hit_df %>%
      group_by(phrase, label) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = label,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    # 防止某一列不存在
    if (!"0" %in% names(out)) out[["0"]] <- 0
    if (!"1" %in% names(out)) out[["1"]] <- 0

    out <- out %>%
      transmute(
        phrase = phrase,
        dep_hits = `1`,
        non_hits = `0`,
        dep_prop = dep_hits / n_dep,
        non_prop = non_hits / n_non,
        diff_prop = dep_prop - non_prop,
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      right_join(
        data.frame(phrase = patterns, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        by = "phrase"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        dep_hits = coalesce(dep_hits, 0),
        non_hits = coalesce(non_hits, 0),
        dep_prop = coalesce(dep_prop, 0),
        non_prop = coalesce(non_prop, 0),
        diff_prop = coalesce(diff_prop, 0),
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
  }

  write.xlsx(
    out,
    here("OUTPUT", paste0("Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_", prefix_name, "_pure.xlsx")),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  cat("已导出：", paste0("Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_", prefix_name, "_pure.xlsx"), "\n")
  out
}

m3_phrase_summary <- phrase_summary_nonoverlap(ml_hit, delete_m3, "M3")
m4_phrase_summary <- phrase_summary_nonoverlap(ml_hit, delete_m4, "M4")

print(head(m3_phrase_summary, 20))
print(head(m4_phrase_summary, 20))

# =========================================================
# 6. 对 M3 / M4 单表述做 Fisher 精确检验 + BH校正
# =========================================================

add_fisher_stats <- function(df, n_dep, n_non) {
  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fisher_res = list(
        fisher.test(
          matrix(
            c(
              dep_hits,
              n_dep - dep_hits,
              non_hits,
              n_non - non_hits
            ),
            nrow = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )
        )
      ),
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_res$estimate),
      conf_low = fisher_res$conf.int[1],
      conf_high = fisher_res$conf.int[2]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    select(
      phrase,
      dep_hits, non_hits,
      dep_prop, non_prop, diff_prop, ratio_prop,
      odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high,
      p_value, p_adj_bh
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
}

# 当前数据里的两组总人数
n_dep <- sum(ml_hit$label == 1)
n_non <- sum(ml_hit$label == 0)

# M3
m3_phrase_summary_fisher <- add_fisher_stats(
  m3_phrase_summary,
  n_dep = n_dep,
  n_non = n_non
)

write.xlsx(
  m3_phrase_summary_fisher,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M3_pure_with_fisher.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M3_pure_with_fisher.xlsx\n")

# M4
m4_phrase_summary_fisher <- add_fisher_stats(
  m4_phrase_summary,
  n_dep = n_dep,
  n_non = n_non
)

write.xlsx(
  m4_phrase_summary_fisher,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M4_pure_with_fisher.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M4_pure_with_fisher.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 7. 打印校正后显著的表述
# =========================================================
cat("\n===== M3：BH校正后显著的表述（p_adj_bh < 0.05）=====\n")
print(
  m3_phrase_summary_fisher %>%
    filter(p_adj_bh < 0.05),
  n = 100
)

cat("\n===== M4：BH校正后显著的表述（p_adj_bh < 0.05）=====\n")
print(
  m4_phrase_summary_fisher %>%
    filter(p_adj_bh < 0.05),
  n = 100
)
```

```{r}
# 0. 读取纯抑郁版机器学习总数据
# =========================================================

  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text),

cat("抑郁组样本数：", sum(ml_data$label == 1), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 1. 读取 4问卷已覆盖症状对应表述
# =========================================================
phrases_4scales <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "phrases_measured_by_4scales_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

phrases_4scales <- phrases_4scales[phrases_4scales != ""]
phrases_4scales <- phrases_4scales[order(nchar(phrases_4scales), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("4问卷已覆盖表述数量：", length(phrases_4scales), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 2. 核心函数：长表述优先，命中后遮罩，避免短表述重复命中
# =========================================================
mask_phrase_fixed <- function(text, phrase, mask_char = "□") {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(text)
  mask_str <- str_dup(mask_char, str_length(phrase))
  str_replace_all(text, fixed(phrase), mask_str)
}

detect_patterns_nonoverlap <- function(text, patterns) {
  if (is.na(text) || trimws(text) == "") {
    return(list(
      hit_any = FALSE,
      n_hit = 0L,
      hit_phrases = character(0),
      masked_text = text
    ))
  }

  working_text <- text
  hit_phrases <- character(0)

  for (p in patterns) {
    if (str_detect(working_text, fixed(p))) {
      hit_phrases <- c(hit_phrases, p)
      working_text <- mask_phrase_fixed(working_text, p)
    }
  }

  list(
    hit_any = length(hit_phrases) > 0,
    n_hit = length(hit_phrases),
    hit_phrases = hit_phrases,
    masked_text = working_text
  )
}

batch_detect_nonoverlap <- function(text_vec, patterns) {
  res <- lapply(text_vec, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  tibble(
    hit_any = vapply(res, function(x) x$hit_any, logical(1)),
    n_hit = vapply(res, function(x) x$n_hit, integer(1)),
    hit_phrases = vapply(res, function(x) paste(x$hit_phrases, collapse = " | "), character(1)),
    masked_text = vapply(res, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$masked_text) || is.na(x$masked_text)) "" else x$masked_text
    }, character(1))
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 3. 每个样本：是否命中、命中多少（非重叠版）
# =========================================================
det_4scales <- batch_detect_nonoverlap(ml_data$history_text, phrases_4scales)

ml_hit_4scales <- ml_data %>%
  mutate(
    hit_any_4scales = det_4scales$hit_any,
    n_hit_4scales = det_4scales$n_hit,
    hit_phrases_4scales = det_4scales$hit_phrases
  )

write.xlsx(
  ml_hit_4scales,
  here("OUTPUT", "Sample_level_phrase_hits_4scales_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出样本级命中表：Sample_level_phrase_hits_4scales_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 4. 整体命中率比较（组水平）
# =========================================================
overall_summary_4scales <- ml_hit_4scales %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_hit_any_4scales = mean(hit_any_4scales),
    mean_n_hit_4scales = mean(n_hit_4scales),
    median_n_hit_4scales = median(n_hit_4scales),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(label == 1, "Depression", "Non-depression")) %>%
  select(group, everything(), -label)

print(overall_summary_4scales)

write.xlsx(
  overall_summary_4scales,
  here("OUTPUT", "Group_level_phrase_hit_summary_4scales_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出组水平汇总表：Group_level_phrase_hit_summary_4scales_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 5. 单表述组间比较（非重叠归属版）
# =========================================================
phrase_summary_nonoverlap <- function(data, patterns) {
  det_list <- lapply(data$history_text, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  hit_rows <- lapply(seq_along(det_list), function(i) {
    hp <- det_list[[i]]$hit_phrases
    if (length(hp) == 0) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      ID = data$ID[i],
      label = data$label[i],
      phrase = hp,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  hit_df <- bind_rows(hit_rows)

  n_dep <- sum(data$label == 1)
  n_non <- sum(data$label == 0)

  if (nrow(hit_df) == 0) {
    out <- data.frame(
      phrase = patterns,
      dep_hits = 0,
      non_hits = 0,
      dep_prop = 0,
      non_prop = 0,
      diff_prop = 0,
      ratio_prop = NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    out <- hit_df %>%
      group_by(phrase, label) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = label,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    if (!"0" %in% names(out)) out[["0"]] <- 0
    if (!"1" %in% names(out)) out[["1"]] <- 0

    out <- out %>%
      transmute(
        phrase = phrase,
        dep_hits = `1`,
        non_hits = `0`,
        dep_prop = dep_hits / n_dep,
        non_prop = non_hits / n_non,
        diff_prop = dep_prop - non_prop,
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      right_join(
        data.frame(phrase = patterns, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        by = "phrase"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        dep_hits = coalesce(dep_hits, 0),
        non_hits = coalesce(non_hits, 0),
        dep_prop = coalesce(dep_prop, 0),
        non_prop = coalesce(non_prop, 0),
        diff_prop = coalesce(diff_prop, 0),
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
  }

  out
}

phrase_summary_4scales <- phrase_summary_nonoverlap(ml_hit_4scales, phrases_4scales)

write.xlsx(
  phrase_summary_4scales,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_level_group_comparison_4scales_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出单表述组间比较表：Phrase_level_group_comparison_4scales_pure.xlsx\n")

print(head(phrase_summary_4scales, 20))

# =========================================================
# 6. Fisher 精确检验 + BH校正
# =========================================================
n_dep <- sum(ml_hit_4scales$label == 1)
n_non <- sum(ml_hit_4scales$label == 0)

add_fisher_stats <- function(df, n_dep, n_non) {
  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fisher_res = list(
        fisher.test(
          matrix(
            c(
              dep_hits,
              n_dep - dep_hits,
              non_hits,
              n_non - non_hits
            ),
            nrow = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )
        )
      ),
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_res$estimate),
      conf_low = fisher_res$conf.int[1],
      conf_high = fisher_res$conf.int[2]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    select(
      phrase,
      dep_hits, non_hits,
      dep_prop, non_prop, diff_prop, ratio_prop,
      odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high,
      p_value, p_adj_bh
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
}

phrase_summary_4scales_fisher <- add_fisher_stats(
  phrase_summary_4scales,
  n_dep,
  n_non
)

write.xlsx(
  phrase_summary_4scales_fisher,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_level_group_comparison_4scales_pure_with_fisher.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出 Fisher 检验结果：Phrase_level_group_comparison_4scales_pure_with_fisher.xlsx\n")

cat("\n校正后显著（BH < 0.05）的表述：\n")
print(
  phrase_summary_4scales_fisher %>%
    filter(p_adj_bh < 0.05),
  n = 50
)
```
